'''Gercor's Retreat''' was a palace maintained by the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kor Besadii]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The palace was built across hundreds of islands in the centre of a large swamp and had a decentralized, village-like structure. The palace's buildings included entertainment halls, vaults and private dwellings for members of the Besadii clan.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
